Scope of Supply: The successful bidder shall supply, install, test and commission the Walk-Through Met al Detector (33 Zone) complete with all standard accessories, cables, power supply arrangements, operati ng manuals and other essential components required for its satisfactory functioning. 4.. Installation and Commissioning: The successful bidder shall be responsible for installation, testing and c ommissioning of the equipment at the designated premises without any additional cost to the Department. 5.. Demonstration and Training: The supplier shall provide a live demonstration of the equipment and impa rt necessary operational training to the personnel nominated by the Department, free of cost. 6. Warranty: The equipment shall carry a comprehensive onsite warranty of at least 02 (Two) years from t he date of successful installation, commissioning and acceptance by the Department. During the warranty period, all defective parts shall be repaired or replaced free of cost. 7. After-Sales Service: The bidder/OEM shall provide adequate after-sales service and technical support. A ny complaint regarding malfunctioning of the equipment shall be attended to within 48 hours of intimation and rectified within a reasonable time. 8. Technical Compliance: The equipment offered must strictly conform to the technical specifications presc ribed in the GeM Bid. The bidder shall submit a duly filled technical compliance statement along with supp orting product literature/brochures. 9. Replacement of Defective Equipment: Any equipment found defective, damaged or not conforming to th e approved specifications shall be replaced or rectified by the supplier at its own cost, without any financi al liability to the Department. 10 Accessories All standard accessories required for installation and operation

11 Warranty: Minimum 02 years comprehensive onsite warranty 2. Additional Conditions 1. 1. The equipment shall be supplied in its original packaging, along with all necessary accessories an d user manuals. 2. 2.
